text: This week was flagged due to evidence from three triggered rules. The most notable anomaly is the elevated number of files copied to removable media, with 68 files copied, significantly above their usual range of 43-54. Additionally, the overall activity volume is far outside the peer distribution, with 167 file operations and 665 web requests, both exceeding their typical ranges by a wide margin. Finally, there was atypical browsing behavior, with 31 visits to job-search sites, well above their usual number of 10.50.
